note: Complete integer coverage strengthens the E2 relaxation only. Partial universes never provide pricing bounds. Independent prefix replay checks all enumerated task-set minimum costs; every exported full LP matrix is checked and reoptimized. No complete M5 integer optimality or infeasibility proof follows from LP convergence.
